intent: study the opposite: suppression, anti-alignment, reversed intervention, inverse inference, missing invariants and adversarial nulls

contrasts.mechanism: heads may contribute opposing signed logit directions after value/output projections; attention probabilities themselves remain non-negative
contrasts.null_test: ablate pre-W_O, compare log-prob with matched head/layer and patching controls

contrasts.mechanism: permutation of complete head outputs together with the matching output-projection blocks leaves the multihead attention output unchanged
contrasts.null_test: permutation without output-projection coupling must NOT generally preserve output

contrasts.mechanism: for n keys, row sum of 1-A is n-1; complement cannot generally be interpreted as inverse attention, and when renormalized is a heuristic change in routing
contrasts.null_test: test n>=3, row-sum and matching output effect

contrasts.lhs: clean head activation injected into contrast
contrasts.mechanism: restoration and disruption measure non-equivalent causal questions; interactions and downstream compensation change outcome
contrasts.null_test: pairwise patching both directions and random/control replacements

contrasts.mechanism: interacting heads, residual paths and bypasses mean individually inferred effects do not necessarily add
contrasts.null_test: pre-projection ablation, held-out metrics, pairwise intervention vs additive prediction

contrasts.mechanism: EEG alignment and direct contribution to computation can dissociate; neither is proof that AI heads mimic neural circuitry
contrasts.null_test: compare brain-alignment-selected heads with attribution-selected ablations

contrasts.mechanism: for I=J=1/2, spin-coupled triplet F=1 (3 substates) vs singlet F=0 (1 substate); hyperfine transition ~1420.4 MHz
contrasts.null_test: check F degeneracy, selection, line energy; spin states not attention heads

contrasts.mechanism: two directions of a radiative transition, but intensity and rates depend on level populations, line-of-sight, optical depth and radiation environment
contrasts.null_test: compare radiative transfer, population inversion/thermal regime, no unconditional equality

contrasts.mechanism: formal chemical reversal conserves charge and nuclei but kinetic reversibility and rate are environment-dependent, not assured equal
contrasts.null_test: compare threshold/rate at specified T, density, plasma and energy, never infer detailed balance from writing reverse arrow

contrasts.mechanism: inverse is often nonidentifiable; distinct physical models can produce similar observations after nuisance/selection effects
contrasts.null_test: fit ΛCDM, CPL, RLL matched covariance and held-out data; posterior predictive checks; no model confirmed

contrasts.mechanism: constant map can trivially pass some consistency/closure rules while discarding all physical information
contrasts.null_test: require both closure AND observable preservation/nonzero recoverable variation

contrasts.mechanism: same spectral/correlation pattern in different systems does not establish shared cause; test RLL vs LCDM with independent data and full covariance
contrasts.null_test: strict WS01, blind holdout, systematic injection, risk of false positives

contrasts.mechanism: zeroing arbitrary output channels after W_O is not equal to ablating a single head before mixing
contrasts.null_test: compare top-head rankings, layer-matched controls, correct intervention and continuous metrics

contrasts.mechanism: both may be represented as correlation/spectral peaks; different physical systems, scales, and dynamical mechanisms
contrasts.null_test: mechanism-derived spectrum, units, dynamics and independently calibrated measurement of each system

governance.scope: graph and deterministic synthetic tests; no real language-model internals, lab spectra or RLL likelihood
governance.null_rule: a null may be accepted only when its target consequence is checked; all-zero degeneracy fails observable preservation

r3.f_ok: mechanistic contrasts and fully typed negative controls, plus local deterministic synthetic tests when executed
r3.f_gap: real instrument/actual model controlled interventions and RLL physical likelihood
r3.f_next: run exact-head suite, independent head-ablation on a permissible open model with proper matched controls, reconcile cosmology WS01 with preregistered tolerances
